limitations.zh: 第二批8人已另存 data/cn-entities-extra.json：逐名核对公安部公告的官方搜索索引摘录，原站正文仍返回521。该8条已补入历史身份检索，但完整别名、身份标识和当前状态尚待核验。
limitations.en: The second batch of 8 persons is separately included in data/cn-entities-extra.json, with each name corroborated against indexed extracts of official MPS announcements. The original pages still return HTTP 521; complete aliases, identity fields and current status require review.

limitations.zh: 已补充的公安部历史人员记录保留可核实的官方英文拼写；中文姓名、全量别名和身份证件尚未逐条核齐。
limitations.en: Added historical MPS records retain verified official English spellings; Chinese names, full aliases and identity documents remain incomplete.

limitations.zh: 联合国官方XML已独立保存为 data/un-entities-auxiliary.json（1010条：736人、274实体），默认不纳入中国法检索，仅供用户明确选择联合国辅助核对。中国执行通知、具体措施、船舶清单、豁免及动态移除仍需逐项映射；其中121条伊朗制度记录尤其不可自动视作中国法禁止。
limitations.en: The official UN XML has been separately ingested into data/un-entities-auxiliary.json (1,010 records: 736 individuals and 274 entities). It is excluded from default Chinese-law screening and available only as an explicitly selected UN auxiliary source. Chinese implementation notices, regime-specific measures, vessel lists, exemptions and delistings still require mapping. In particular, the 121 Iran-regime entries must not automatically be treated as Chinese-law prohibitions.

limitations.zh: 历史外交部记者会、未公开具体姓名的反制、各名单的所有后续变更及未列名但可能受措施影响的关联主体，未获得穷尽性认证。
limitations.en: Historical press statements, unnamed countermeasures, every subsequent status change and unnamed affiliates potentially affected by measures have not been exhaustively certified.

The notice prohibits recognizing, enforcing or complying with the specified U.S. sanctions imposed under Executive Orders 13902, 13846 and related provisions over Iranian oil dealings. If a U.S. list also matches, retain both results and obtain legal review of jurisdiction, the specific measures, exemptions/licenses and the legal conflict. Do not automatically select one regime to follow.

noticeTitle.zh: 国台办发言人就惩戒“台独”顽固分子关联企业答记者问
noticeTitle.en: Taiwan Affairs Office statement ending specified measures against Skyla

restrictions.zh: 国台办2023年7月13日宣布，即日起不再对天亮医疗采取禁止大陆组织、企业、个人与其交易合作及禁止负责人入境等措施；该表态同时说明其他三家企业的惩戒措施保持不变。只更新本措施，不据此撤销其他可能适用的独立措施。
restrictions.en: On July 13, 2023, the Taiwan Affairs Office announced that the stated transaction/cooperation and responsible-person entry measures would no longer apply to Skyla. The same statement retained measures against the other three companies. This ends the specified measures only and does not cancel any separate applicable measure.
